explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 84 named tracks across current techno and experimental listings, adjacent bass/electronic releases, emerging-label pages and overlooked electronic, dub and sound-system catalogue. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Completed Runs 213, 214, 217, 218 and 219 selected identities and source fields were excluded; failed Run 212 identities and the six unresolved Mark Fell leads from Run 197 were not reused.

Every exact artist/title pair below was checked against the canonical ledger, target discoveries, local discovery pool, active rejections, PARKED revisit queue and global utility ledger before ranking; none was present.
The repetition check compared the previous five completed discovery runs (213, 214, 217, 218 and 219). None of the nine placements repeats a selected-candidate boundary from those runs.

Run 220's activated evidence guard is applied: all nine leads come from different releases, and the three strongest slots carry candidate-specific descriptions of direction, development or material rather than shared release framing.

Nine honest leads survived without padding. The protected Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer internal order and both protected handoffs remain untouched. No Spotify connector, raw audio, invented identity or metadata-to-feeling inference was used.
